propositions: When evidence search exhausts its step budget without refuting criteria, the gate should auto-resume verification instead of failing to the operator
A resumption is a whole-verifier re-run that reuses the existing verify_completion entry with the same ref binding and seeds the verdict cache with previously credited PASSes

Auto-resume qualifies only for insufficiency-only FAILs where every unmet criterion carries the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker, determined by reusing the existing _insufficiency_only predicate

Resumption attempts are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max config (default 2, 0 disables) and progress condition: a resumption dispatches only when prior attempt strictly increased cache-credited PASS count
The resumption loop sits at the shared close gate seam in close_precheck._completion_precheck so CLI, MCP, and library closes all exercise it via transition_close.close_ticket

Per-attempt trail records attempt number, cache-credited count, and remaining unmet count, surfaced on ticket or close output; zero-progress attempts stop early and surface existing failure with attempts-count message
